result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues: restaurant names and cards are cut off, category chips overflow, and delivery time badges have weak contrast on light images.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the Fastest near you row, and the third card is partially clipped off-screen with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles use ellipsis or wrap fully, and show partial next cards with enough peek width or a clearer horizontal scroll indicator so names and content are not cut off.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) overflows the screen edge with a clipped chip on the right and no visible scroll cue.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with padding/peek of the next chip, or wrap/scroll chips so none are hard-clipped at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The Popular right now section’s second promo card is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, so users only see a partial image and badge.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards and text aren’t obscured, and ensure lists scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Delivery time badges (e.g. '15–25 min') sit on light food imagery with low contrast, making the white pill and dark text harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a stronger scrim/shadow behind badges or a consistently opaque background so label text remains readable on any image.

issues.description: Promo banner and section headers are fine, but truncated names and clipped cards make key restaurant info incomplete at a glance.
issues.suggestion: Prefer shorter display names, responsive type, or two-line titles so primary labels stay fully legible in the card grid.
